jobDesc: Architected AgencyHeight from scratch: a Next.js/React insurance marketplace used by 3,000+ agents, built as a Turborepo + pnpm monorepo with 10+ shared packages (ui, auth, api, state, analytics).
Shipped an LLM feature on the OpenAI and Gemini APIs that writes profile bios for insurance agents from their NPN.
Cut bundle size by 30% and improved Core Web Vitals scores by 46% versus the legacy platform.
Set the engineering standards the team follows: strict TypeScript, Biome, Husky + commitlint, a feature → dev → qa → production flow and Dockerized builds; review pull requests and prepare releases.

Built the design system (shadcn/ui, Radix UI, shared Tailwind preset) and the data layer (TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod); set up Vitest, Playwright and axe-core testing with Sentry and Datadog in production.
Led the insured customer portal, now driving 70–100 policy inquiries a week at about 20% conversion into the agent sales pipeline.
Built the interactive visualization layer of the Census Nepal 2021 portal, turning raw demographic data into accessible, citizen-facing charts on tight government timelines.
Shipped internal admin dashboards for the Municipal Association of Nepal (293 municipalities) and the World Bank–funded DGM Nepal program: data visualization, user management and daily reporting.
Owned the frontend of Sarang, a responsive travel-guide platform built for low-bandwidth mobile users and desktops across Nepal.
Developed a university website with an elegant design and intuitive user experience.
Collaborated with product, design and backend teams in an Agile, Git/GitLab workflow to ship filtering, analytics dashboards and dynamic forms against REST APIs.
Built conversion-focused marketing sites and custom WordPress solutions for construction, real estate and consultancy clients.
Translated designs into pixel-accurate, responsive builds focused on project portfolios, client engagement and performance.
Shipped features for an online document-filling platform and the company website, plus user-facing optimizations and production bug fixes.
